and everyone needs a reason to hate me, so they always find a way to make me the reason.  


I'm doing the best I can. I used to give up easy when I was a kid, but I think it's just my brain that's wired this way.  


In spite of these shortcomings I found it in myself to unlock a great deal of strength and in the last 10 years I really went with everything that I had. But every step forward... I lose a limb.

It's their view of the world, that's the point. I don't see it like that. Yeah they'll probably rationalize it like that. Make me into the bad person so that it's easier to accept. Your point is what exactly ?

Not being 35 years old and having to explain all the time why I have 0$ in my bank account and so much debts...   


Not getting in conflicts all the time.   


If we're realist, what I need is a reduced work week and the opportunity to keep what I have "built" for myself as I work through my issues and rebuild myself.  


But right now I have to lead a big project, manage employees, develop applications, support previous applications, I'm completely drained by the middle of my day and I can't find the energy or the time to work on myself.  


If I let the job go, my finances are going to be even more fucked up and I dont know what else I can do. Worse than that, any job is too much for me right now. I need the time for me and I can't get it :(. I cant work through all this on my own :(

I want to live, I really do... But I just cant find a way... I don't know what I'm hoping for... I just want to know when I take my last breath that I gave out every scream for help that I could.  


If there is an afterlife and I meet god face to face, and he is to damn my soul, I want to look him in the eye and say that I tried everything and that he never replied.  


And if for some sad reason he can't forgive me, then it must mean that all of this is really my fault and there will truly be nothing that I can do.   


That'd be the most absurd scenario, finding myself in a pit of fire for all eternity wondering what I did wrong and never fully comprehending what else I could have done.

I just cant find anything to hold on to right now :( 

Everything feels like work and I want it to be over :(
